note: Evaluation has no constructed prefixes and no scheduled matching states. Family inventories are generated from a predeclared type-set rule that does not consult the memory table. Seeds are paired comparisons on identical starts, not independent learned memories. Results are summarised across independent streams. The table and selected transforms are frozen before evaluation; there is no online memory growth. Initial-state hits are reported separately from intermediate hits after autonomous placements.
